correctness.rationale: Under simplex-preimage continuity, every non-injective element has exactly one doubled fiber {center,leaf}; when its image is center, no other image exists; when leaf, remaining source leaves inject into other target leaves. Injective maps split by whether center is in image. This yields P=F_{m,m+1}+2mt+tF_m+m²t²+m²tF_{m−1}. Idempotents consist of partial identities and fixed-point double fibers, giving E=(1+t)^(m+1)+mt(1+(1+t)^(m−1)). Regularity iff a continuous section exists; each doubled-fiber map has a section, whereas the injective nonregular maps have rank r≥2, image all leaves, and domain containing center, giving N=Σ binom(m,r)binom(m,r−1)r!t^r. The proof counts partial labeled maps for m≥3 (m=1,2 boundary checks), not ordinary homomorphisms. Independent exhaustive definition-level enumeration at m=3: P=(1,28,90,60,6), E=(1,10,12,7,1), nonregular coefficients rank2=18, rank3=18, matching formulas.
